name: Tozasareta Fuyu
source:
College student Misaki Kinosaki was looking for a part-time job that could only be done during winter vacation. She finds a job offer in her student affairs department.
『Recruitment of servants. Miscellaneous chores in the mansion. Handing over rewards Apply by mail』
Interested in the rarity of her work at her mansion, she applied immediately. The result was adoption. Her designated place of work is so deep in the mountains that it is impossible to get there without using a car, and the taxi driver who brought her is worried. While feeling a little uneasy, she was greeted by a beautiful young hostess named Suzue Fujikawa at the Western-style building. There is only one Suzue in this mansion. She employs only one servant, Misaki, and her work includes cleaning and cooking, but Misaki takes care of "Suzue-san". That was all.
--A meaningful dream.
--The hostess with many mysteries.
--A creepy photo.
In this mansion standing under the cloudy winter sky, mysterious things happen one after another.
Even so, Misaki deepens her friendship with the owner of the mansion, Suzue Fujikawa...
translation:
大學生城崎ミサキ，正在尋找一份只需寒假期間做的兼職。她在學生事務部門，發現了一則招聘。
「招募傭人。負責宅邸雜務。報酬面議。請以郵件申請。」
難得見到在宅邸工作的機會，她立刻應徵，並順利錄取。指定的工作地點位於深山，沒有車根本無法抵達，就連送她過來的計程車司機，也有些擔心。懷著幾分不安，她來到西式宅邸，受到美麗年輕的女主人藤川すずえ迎接。宅邸中，只有すずえ一人。她也只僱用了ミサキ這一個傭人，工作包括打掃與做飯。ミサキ所需做的，就是照顧「すずえ小姐」，僅此而已。
——意味深長的夢。
——謎團重重的女主人。
——令人不安的照片。
在陰沉冬空下佇立的宅邸中，怪事接連發生。
即便如此，ミサキ仍與宅邸主人藤川すずえ，逐漸加深了友誼……
